check_trf007_violations: check a Python AST tree for TRF007 violations where self.* is assigned after self.post_init() in __init__
test_post_init_placement: test that self.post_init() is called last in __init__ of pretrained model classes
refactor_post_init_order: refactor a model's __init__ to move self.post_init() to the end after all self.* assignments
review_post_init_usage: review a pretrained model class to ensure self.post_init() remains at the end of __init__
summarize_trf007_rule: summarize the TRF007 lint rule that enforces self.post_init() at the end of __init__ in pretrained classes
